verdict.rationale: pnpm's frozen-lockfile CI mode ensures installs fail rather than silently drift from the lockfile, and its content-addressable store with hard-linked node_modules guarantees the exact same resolved package files across machines; community reports corroborate fast, consistent installs across large monorepos. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of byte-identical installs across different OSes/architectures, and no explicit documentation of lockfile version-mismatch error handling.
